rows.label: qst650502_msg0001
rows.name: Gah-!

rows.label: qst650502_msg0002
rows.name: What is this place?!

rows.label: qst650502_msg0003
rows.name: Are... Are you okay?!

rows.label: qst650502_msg0004
rows.name: You're...not Bias...?

rows.label: qst650502_msg0005
rows.name:
I've said this several times
now, but what are these
'Bias' you keep talking about?

rows.label: qst650502_msg0006
rows.name:
There are people from Gula,
Superbia, and Luxuria here,
but I've never heard of Bias.

rows.label: qst650502_msg0007
rows.name:
Nor do I, I'm afraid. I do not
recall ever hearing of them.

rows.label: qst650502_msg0008
rows.name:
Until just now, you all looked
like Bias... like my enemies...

rows.label: qst650502_msg0009
rows.name:
I thought this was battle simulation.
You're saying it's all real? Was this
that trader's plan all along...?

rows.label: qst650502_msg0010
rows.name: Good catch, mo.

rows.label: qst650502_msg0011
rows.name: Whoa! He appeared!

rows.label: qst650502_msg0012
rows.name:
Don't react like you've run
into some named monster, mo!

rows.label: qst650502_msg0013
rows.name:
Nopon Great Sage-san... So you were
the one behind this after all.

rows.label: qst650502_msg0014
rows.name:
Ahem, mo! There's not much the
Nopon Great Sage can't do, mo!

rows.label: qst650502_msg0015
rows.name: That's a weird thing to boast about...

rows.label: qst650502_msg0016
rows.name:
I did wonder why a run-of-the-mill
trader was calling himself the
"Nopon Great Sage"...

rows.label: qst650502_msg0017
rows.name:
What exactly did you do
to that battle simulator?

rows.label: qst650502_msg0018
rows.name:
I just sent Elma's consciousness
to this Land of Challenge, mo.

rows.label: qst650502_msg0019
rows.name:
So the real me is still in NLA,
inside the battle simulator?

rows.label: qst650502_msg0020
rows.name:
That's right, mo. Glad you're
quick on the uptake, mo.

rows.label: qst650502_msg0021
rows.name:
You say it's only my consciousness,
but it feels like I'm physically
here. What is this for...?

rows.label: qst650502_msg0022
rows.name:
Glad you asked, mo! It's all for
the Nopon Great Sage's ambition!
It's been his dream for years, mo!

rows.label: qst650502_msg0023
rows.name: Dream? What dream?

rows.label: qst650502_msg0024
rows.name:
Maybe it's to let Elma
and me meet you, Rex.

rows.label: qst650502_msg0025
rows.name:
Just as Shulk says, mo! Shulk and Elma
coming here is everyone's dream, mo!

rows.label: qst650502_msg0026
rows.name: Who exactly is 'everyone'...?

rows.label: qst650502_msg0027
rows.name:
Unbelievable. You went to all
this trouble just for that...?

rows.label: qst650502_msg0028
rows.name:
No. More importantly, I should
apologize to all of you first.

rows.label: qst650502_msg0029
rows.name:
Even if I mistook you for enemies,
I was still wrong to attack without
warning. I hope you can forgive me.

rows.label: qst650502_msg0030
rows.name:
Relax, there's nothing to
overlook! It was all just
a big misunderstanding.

rows.label: qst650502_msg0031
rows.name: My name's Rex. What's yours?

rows.label: qst650502_msg0032
qst650502_msg0033
rows.name: Oh, you're a Blade...

rows.label: qst650502_msg0034
rows.name: Oh, um, yes... You know about BLADEs?

rows.label: qst650502_msg0035
rows.name:
Know about them? We're all
Blades and their Drivers.

rows.label: qst650502_msg0036
rows.name: Drivers?

rows.label: qst650502_msg0037
rows.name: Hana is the only artificial Blade, mo!

rows.label: qst650502_msg0038
rows.name: N-no, hold on, I'm getting confused...

rows.label: qst650502_msg0039
rows.name:
It seems 'Blade' means
something completely different
in Rex's world and Elma's.

rows.label: qst650502_msg0040
rows.name: That's what makes it interesting, mo!

rows.label: qst650502_msg0041
rows.name:
In our world, BLADE is the
name of an organization.

rows.label: qst650502_msg0042
rows.name:
And in yours, it's a...species?
Race? Is that correct?

rows.label: qst650502_msg0043
rows.name: Well, that's close, but not quite...

rows.label: qst650502_msg0044
rows.name:
A Blade is a variant life-form born
when a person touches a Core Crystal.

rows.label: qst650502_msg0045
rows.name:
A variant life-form... So
that's why Blades come in
so many different forms.

rows.label: qst650502_msg0046
rows.name:
But Elma-san, you're not surprised
that Gramps or Byakko can talk.

rows.label: qst650502_msg0047
rows.name:
Right, well... Maybe I'm just
used to it. Many different
races call Mira home...

rows.label: qst650502_msg0048
rows.name:
And we could all communicate without
difficulty... Some even thought it was
deliberate interference by someone.

rows.label: qst650502_msg0049
rows.name:
Planet Mira... I've never heard
of it, but your world seems very
different from ours, Elma-san.

rows.label: qst650502_msg0050
rows.name:
The Bionis and Alst didn't feel
all that different, though.

rows.label: qst650502_msg0051
rows.name:
Yeah! I even wondered if you might've
come from a humanoid Divine Beast.

rows.label: qst650502_msg0052
rows.name:
Hold on. There's something
I want to check.

rows.label: qst650502_msg0053
rows.name:
Wh-what is it, mo...?
Elma-onee-chan, do you have
some grudge against Tora, mo?

rows.label: qst650502_msg0054
rows.name: Tora, why are you panicking like that?

rows.label: qst650502_msg0055
rows.name:
Tora doesn't owe anyone in another
world money, mo! Tora has no
reason for you to glare at him, mo!

rows.label: qst650502_msg0056
rows.name:
That way of speaking... unmistakable.
You said you're Tora? The Nopon
who's friends with Tatsu...?

rows.label: qst650502_msg0057
rows.name: Mo-mo-mo?!

rows.label: qst650502_msg0058
rows.name:
Tora doesn't know him, mo! Tora
has no friend named Tatsu, mo!

rows.label: qst650502_msg0059
rows.name:
I see... Now that you mention it,
maybe I've got the wrong Nopon.

rows.label: qst650502_msg0060
rows.name:
The Tora I know was
smaller and cuter...

rows.label: qst650502_msg0061
rows.name:
Mo-mo... Tora is on the large
side for a Nopon, but his
cuteness is well established...

rows.label: qst650502_msg0062
rows.name:
Yes, yes, enough obsessing over
that. We'll never get anywhere.

rows.label: qst650502_msg0063
rows.name:
You said 'Nopon people' just now. Is
that different from the Nopon race?

rows.label: qst650502_msg0064
rows.name:
The appearance and mannerisms are
the same. I can't really see any
major differences on the whole...

rows.label: qst650502_msg0065
rows.name:
Even so, it may be evidence that
our worlds are different... Though
perhaps that's obvious by now.

rows.label: qst650502_msg0066
rows.name:
Rex, Shulk... I'm convinced you're
not virtual beings in a simulator.

rows.label: qst650502_msg0067
rows.name:
That's a relief. Then I'm sure
we can become friends, right?

rows.label: qst650502_msg0068
rows.name:
Right. We get along well with
Homura and the others, after all.

rows.label: qst650502_msg0069
rows.name:
Yes, I certainly get
that impression...

rows.label: qst650502_msg0070
rows.name:
Mo-mo-mo! This is the
sight I wanted to see, mo!

rows.label: qst650502_msg0071
rows.name:
For an Archsage, he's sure got
some kiddy-like dreams, eh?

rows.label: qst650502_msg0072
rows.name: You could say that again...

rows.label: qst650502_msg0073
rows.name:
Don't make fun of the
Nopon Great Sage's dream, mo!

rows.label: qst650502_msg0074
rows.name:
You can gain lots of
experience, and you might get
some incredible items too, mo!

rows.label: qst650502_msg0075
rows.name:
It's not a bad offer, but I have
duties as a member of BLADE.

rows.label: qst650502_msg0076
rows.name:
I can't afford to spend hours
on end stuck in a simulator.

rows.label: qst650502_msg0077
rows.name:
Don't worry, mo! I've adjusted
the time settings properly, mo.

rows.label: qst650502_msg0078
rows.name:
While one day passes here, only
270 milliseconds pass on Mira, mo.

rows.label: qst650502_msg0079
rows.name:
[ML:Feeling kind=Think ] 'Milliseconds'...? I've
never heard of that unit.

rows.label: qst650502_msg0080
rows.name:
So even if a year passes here, only
about ten seconds pass over there?

rows.label: qst650502_msg0081
rows.name:
Exactly, mo! Wouldn't that make it
perfect for retraining yourself, mo?

rows.label: qst650502_msg0082
rows.name: Y-yes, certainly...

rows.label: qst650502_msg0083
rows.name:
What do you think, Rex, mo?
Want to borrow Elma's power
like Shulk and Fiorung's, mo?

rows.label: qst650502_msg0084
rows.name: Make Elma your ally

rows.label: qst650502_msg0085
rows.name: Leave Elma be

rows.label: qst650502_msg0101
rows.name:
Of course! You can never
have too many allies!

rows.label: qst650502_msg0102
rows.name:
...Then it's decided. From now
on, I'll be at your command.

rows.label: qst650502_msg0103
rows.name:
And I look forward to working
with everyone on Team Rex.

rows.label: qst650502_msg0201
rows.name:
I mean, we still don't
know Elma very well yet...

rows.label: qst650502_msg0202
rows.name:
Then you can get to know me.
There's no better way to understand
each other than fighting together.

rows.label: qst650502_msg0203
rows.name: I... I guess so?

rows.label: qst650502_msg0204
rows.name:
Then it's settled. From now on, I'm
under your command. I look forward to
working with you, leader of Team Rex.

rows.label: qst650502_msg0205
rows.name: And everyone else on the team.

rows.label: qst650502_msg0206
rows.name: What will you do?
